packageRules.description: Renovate moves components/clang22/version and components/objc-receipt-clang/version but cannot write the Linux archive's digest beside either, so the Linux job fails on the bump until the linux-sha256 beside the moved version names the new release's archive.
prBodyNotes: Before this can merge, replace the linux-sha256 beside each moved version (components/clang22, components/objc-receipt-clang) with the `clang22-<version>-linux-x86_64.tar.gz` line of the new release's SHA256SUMS: `gh release download <version> -R Mavergreen/clang-22 -p SHA256SUMS -O - | grep linux-x86_64.tar.gz > components/<dir>/linux-sha256`. An objc-receipt-clang bump must also pass tests/objc-source-inventory-host-test.sh on Linux and a Mac.
